body.label: Work
body.text: Met users to capture dashboard goals, key business questions and layout preferences, and reviewed sample data to confirm the schema and logic the pipeline needed.

body.label: Challenge
body.text: Learning to run user calls independently, without my supervisor present.

body.label: Outcome
body.text: Shadowed my supervisor in the first weeks to learn the approach, and now hold user calls and meetings independently.

body.label: Work
body.text: Cleaned and formatted sample data, designed Hive table schemas and ingested files with Linux commands, with every load audited through the BDMF framework.

body.label: Learning
body.text: A small formatting mistake can break the whole pipeline. Schemas need to reflect structure and meaning, not just storage, and audit trails prove that data was loaded correctly.

body.label: Practice
body.text: Kept a reference file of Linux commands and their functions, which made day-to-day pipeline work faster.

body.label: Challenge
body.text: A single wrong figure could come from schema errors, ingestion problems or logic mistakes.

body.label: Approach
body.text: Documented correct and incorrect values as a reference and validated results against source data.

body.label: Outcome
body.text: Faster troubleshooting, and the habit of anticipating common errors so production processes are safer and more automated.

body.label: Deployment
body.text: Finalised SQL views, PBIX dashboards and ingestion paths, then followed a structured handover into production.

body.label: Collaboration
body.text: Coordinated with the BI and DevOps teams. Clear documentation and proactive communication kept cross-team dependencies from becoming bottlenecks.

body.label: Automation
body.text: Built reusable SQL snippets and Excel templates for future tasks, improving efficiency and reducing manual errors.

body.label: Work
body.text: Gathered requirements before building: data schema, nature and volume of the data, key metrics and business logic.

body.label: Outcome
body.text: Used PowerPoint mockups to confirm the design with users before the build began.

body.label: Work
body.text: Wrote complex SQL with CTEs for maintainable, accurate queries and implemented my own business logic under supervision.

body.label: Challenge
body.text: DAX and Power Query M were new to me.

body.label: Solution
body.text: Learned them through online resources and delivered dashboards that met user expectations, connecting the full path from SQL to Power BI.

body.label: Feedback
body.text: Engaged users iteratively. Each round improved clarity, usability and business alignment.

body.label: Verification
body.text: Validated dashboard metrics against source data by comparing Excel and SQL outputs, which surfaced discrepancies early and improved reliability.

body.label: Learning
body.text: Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Infinity, Jenkins, Bitbucket and Agile sprint planning, and the role each plays in the delivery lifecycle.

body.label: Challenge
body.text: Understanding how the tools, processes and workflows connect.

body.label: Solution
body.text: Created internal workflow guides and checklists and sought mentorship, which built confidence navigating the platforms.

body.label: Learning
body.text: Pre-deployment checks, automated approvals and pipeline monitoring prevent errors, and clearly documented processes make handovers smoother and delivery more consistent.
